steps.en: Add the plugin marketplace in Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里添加插件市场

steps.en: Export your Letta API key — that is the whole config
steps.zh: 设一个 Letta API key，就是全部配置

steps.en: On first use it auto-imports a bundled Subconscious agent with 8 memory blocks
steps.zh: 首次使用时自动导入内置 Subconscious agent 与 8 个记忆块

steps.en: Use Claude Code normally in any project
steps.zh: 在任意项目里照常使用 Claude Code

steps.en: After each response a detached worker replays the transcript; the agent reads files and updates its memory
steps.zh: 后台 worker 重放 transcript，agent 读文件更新记忆

steps.en: Before your next prompt it injects fresh memories and whispers via stdout
steps.zh: 下一次 prompt 前经 stdout 注入新记忆与低语

value.en: Cross-session memory that compounds while you code — without ever editing CLAUDE.md
value.zh: 记忆随会话不断累积，而你从不用改 CLAUDE.md

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (retrieved 2026-09-27): install commands '/plugin marketplace add letta-ai/claude-subconscious' and '/plugin install claude-subconscious@claude-subconscious'; config 'export LETTA_API_KEY="your-api-key"'

README.md 'Default Subconscious Agent': auto-import of bundled Subconscious.af with 8 memory blocks; 'Hooks': Stop async worker (send_messages_to_letta.ts / send_worker_sdk.ts), UserPromptSubmit injects via stdout; 'Multi-Project Usage': one shared agent, per-project .letta/claude/ bookkeeping; 'Modes': Subconscious never writes to CLAUDE.md
